# Diagram quality corpus

Use-case flows written by a coding agent following the casemap skill, for three open-source apps. They are casemap's own descriptions of each app's behaviour, used to measure and pin diagram layout quality; their `@code` anchors refer to paths in the original repositories, not this one.

| Folder | App | Stack | Source (commit mapped) | License |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `commerce/` | Next.js Commerce | Next.js | https://github.com/vercel/commerce (f7521d5) | MIT |
| `healthchecks/` | Healthchecks.io | Django | https://github.com/healthchecks/healthchecks (5a183c3) | BSD-3-Clause |
| `shiori/` | Shiori | Go | https://github.com/go-shiori/shiori (aebb402) | MIT |
